title: Underground Art Fallout
description: A man with gray hair in a red coat stands on a concrete platform inside an abandoned underground bunker. He is surrounded by film reels, scattered VHS tapes, framed paintings, a painter's palette, and a popcorn bucket, with a large graffiti mural of a nuclear explosion and the word STASIS on the cracked wall behind him.
prompt: A gray-haired man wearing a long red coat and blue jeans stands confidently in an abandoned concrete subway station turned artist studio. Behind him is a large cracked wall mural depicting a nuclear mushroom cloud with the word STASIS and celestial motifs. The scene is filled with old film reels, scattered VHS tapes, framed surreal paintings, an artist's palette with paint, and a striped popcorn bucket. Dramatic spotlight from above with purple and green neon tubes, cinematic lighting, gritty textures, detailed environment.
